parsed.reason: The message successfully ties the ask to the introduction ("To introduce you") and asks plainly for both required facts ("your name and email") in a single tight sentence of 15 words. It fits comfortably in one text segment, learning from the prior over-length version by cutting unnecessary padding ("whenever you're ready," "I will take it from there," "text back") while keeping the core ask intact. The phrasing is direct without being curt, and it respects that this parent already knows Hale and has months of history - no re-introduction of what Hale does. The only minor weakness is that "reply with both" could be slightly clearer as "text both back," but it's unambiguous enough not to harm clarity.
